facts.text: The Haudenosaunee Promise Scholarship provides financial assistance equal to the full cost of tuition, housing, meals, and mandatory fees for admitted Haudenosaunee citizens.

sources.title: Syracuse University Scholarships - Financial Aid – Syracuse University
sources.quote: Qualified students receive financial assistance equal to the cost of tuition, housing and meals, and mandatory fees (as outlined in the University's Cost of Attendance per year in college) for each year of full-time undergraduate study.

facts.text: The Coronat Scholars Program awards full-tuition scholarships to incoming first-year students enrolling in the College of Arts and Sciences and the Maxwell School.

sources.title: Syracuse University Scholarships - Financial Aid – Syracuse University
sources.quote: The Coronat Scholars Program is a highly competitive scholarship offered to incoming first-year students enrolling in the College of Arts and Sciences | Maxwell School of Citizenship and Public Affairs. This is a full-tuition scholarship
